meta.name: alterlab-qiime2-amplicon
meta.description: Runs 16S/ITS amplicon (microbiome) analysis with the QIIME 2 amplicon distribution (2026.1; renamed to "qiime2" in 2026.4) in the correct order: manifest import, cutadapt trim-paired primer removal BEFORE dada2 denoise-paired (trunc-len chosen from the demux quality .qzv), feature-classifier classify-sklearn against a version-matched SILVA 138 or Greengenes2 classifier, and diversity core-metrics-phylogenetic — teaching the .qza/.qzv artifact-and-provenance model and the 2026.1 feature-table summarize change (the former summarize_plus). Use when the request mentions QIIME2, QIIME 2, qiime, 16S, 18S, ITS, amplicon, microbiome, ASV, DADA2 denoising, feature table, taxonomic classification, or core-metrics diversity. For downstream alpha/beta diversity, PCoA, and PERMANOVA on the exported feature table prefer alterlab-scikit-bio; this is conda-only (no pip install). Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按正确顺序运行 QIIME 2 的 16S/ITS 扩增子分析流程：导入、引物切除、DADA2 去噪、分类、多样性。它会教你 .qza/.qzv 文件格式和 2026.1 版的变化。
howto.when: 当用户提到 QIIME2、16S、ITS、扩增子、微生物组、ASV、DADA2 等关键词，或要求运行扩增子分析流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 QIIME 2 跑一个 16S 扩增子流程，从 FASTQ 开始。
我有 ITS 的 FASTQ 文件，用 DADA2 去噪并分配分类。
say.note: Claude 会调用 ITS 相关参数和分类器。

say.text: 从质量图中选择截断长度，然后运行核心多样性指标。
say.note: Claude 会指导你查看 .qzv 文件并设置参数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run the QIIME 2 amplicon pipeline for 16S/ITS in the correct order: import, primer trimming, DADA2 denoising, classification, and diversity. It teaches the .qza/.qzv artifact model and the 2026.1 feature-table summarize change.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions QIIME2, 16S, ITS, amplicon, microbiome, ASV, DADA2, or requests running an amplicon analysis pipeline.

say_en.text: Run a QIIME 2 16S pipeline from FASTQ files.
say_en.note: Claude will execute import, primer trim, DADA2 denoising, etc.

say_en.text: Denoise my ITS FASTQs with DADA2 and assign taxonomy.
say_en.note: Claude will use ITS-specific parameters and classifiers.

say_en.text: Pick truncation lengths from the quality plot and run core-metrics diversity.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to inspect the .qzv and set parameters.
